verdict.rationale: Apple's spec page publishes a few hard numbers: core counts, a 16-core Neural Engine and 153GB/s memory bandwidth, and the newsroom cites 32GB memory capacity. Most of the rest is marketing language such as "dramatically accelerated" and "next big leap." The community fills gaps only with leaked Geekbench scores and relative claims like "4x peak GPU compute vs M4," which come without stated test conditions. missing for 10: published CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, Neural Engine AI TOPS, test conditions/methodology for performance claims.
